title: Simply Troll
description: A lightweight plugin, that let you troll your friends
body:
## TrollMaster
The ultimate troll plugin for Paper 1.21+ — 47 unique trolls, full GUI, completely silent to the target.
TrollMaster lets you troll players on your server with style. Open a clean inventory GUI, pick your target, choose a troll from 5 categories, set the strength and duration, and fire. The target never sees a single "[TrollMaster]" message — they'll have no idea what's happening.

## Features
- 47 troll effects across 5 categories
- Full inventory GUI — player selector, category browser, level & duration config
- 4 targeting modes — single player, all players, random player, or radius
- Completely silent — targets receive zero plugin notifications
- Per-troll cooldown system with bypass permission
- Statistics GUI — top trollers, most trolled players, most used trolls
- Auto-Troll mode — automatically trolls random players on a configurable interval
- Immunity permission — protect specific players from all effects
- Tab-completion for all commands
